name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 15 Nov; US storm of 12–14 Nov brought upland snow
state: The storm that crossed the eastern US on 12–14 Nov brought rain to low-lying areas along the I-95 corridor, with accumulating snow confined to higher ground in nine states and no blizzard warnings reported (Newsweek, 10 Nov). Searches on 15 Nov found no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region and no cold-related power or gas outages, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No widespread cold or winter-storm disruption is expected. People in the UK can follow Met Office warnings and UKHSA cold-health alerts as winter approaches.
rubric_hit: Normal: no major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations found on 15 Nov

sources.title: Newsweek — Winter weather storm map shows where snow could fall

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
